notes: Access: direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF/blocking encountered. Platform: Magento 2 (media/sitemap path, standard layered-nav category grid, page size 48). Nav tree pulled via full mega-menu link dump (probe.py nav) plus manual verification of each candidate URL. Counting method: unique 'data-price-amount'/'product-price-<id>' tiles on page 1, combined with the rendered page-count ('toolbar-number 1/N') to fetch the LAST page and sum (N-1)*48 + last_page_count; every total re-verified by fetching one page past the end and confirming zero tiles (exhaustion check). All totals below passed this check with no drift on re-check. /lighting/table-lamps 301-redirects to canonical /lighting/lights/table-lamps (same catalog node, not double-counted). RULE 0: included Bathroom Lights, Garden/Outdoor Lights, and Bathroom Mirrors under their room names per Rule 0.1/0.3/0.4 - old rules would have skipped these on the room word alone. EXCLUDED as out of scope: Lightbulbs & Light Fittings (bulbs/fittings hardware), Home Fragrance (diffusers/scented candles - separate node from Candle Holders, which was spot-checked and found to be genuine candle holders plus unscented novelty shaped candles, no fragrance language on sampled product pages), Matches & Match Strikes, Cutlery, Kitchen Storage & Accessories, Kitchen Textiles, Serving Boards & Utensils (all functional kitchen tools), Bathroom Accessories (spot-checked: toilet-roll holders/towel rails/rings/soap dishes/toothbrush holders - classic bathroom hardware, Rule 0.4 exclusion), Bath Mats/Doormats/Curtains/Cushions/Throws/Bedding (textiles), Fireside (spot-checked: fireside tool sets, log baskets, matches - functional fireplace equipment), Household Storage, Knobs & Handles, Door Stops, Umbrellas (hardware/utility), Barware & Drinks Accessories (spot-checked: dominated by bottle openers/ice buckets/decanter sets/juicer - functional bar tools per exclusion list; its coasters/trays also duplicate Placemats-Coasters-Trays), Placemats-Coasters-and-Trays (spot-checked: majority cork/seagrass/marble placemats and coasters - functional tabletop-protection items, decorative trays a minority and not separable at this URL - dropped as a mixed roll-up rather than padded), Jewellery Boxes & Trinket Trays under Gifts (spot-checked: trinket-dish/tray content duplicates items already captured under Decorative Accessories, jewellery-box content is functional storage - dropped to avoid double count), Fire Pits and Bowls (garden furniture/functional), all Furniture/Rugs/Soft Furnishings/Gifts-for-recipient/Jewellery/Books/Games/Bags branches (out of category entirely), Faux Flowers/The Flower Shop (artificial plants, explicit exclusion). RULE 0.6 overlap documented: Garden Planters & Ornaments (outdoors/garden-accessories/garden-pots-and-planters) shares several exact SKUs (garden-stake ornaments) with Decorative Accessories - kept as a genuine second nav branch (garden/outdoor context vs indoor type tree) per Rule 0.6, since it is not an identical listing at the same level; it also carries a minority of non-decor garden-utility items (bird feeders, kneeling pad, boot jack - roughly 5 of 39) that could not be isolated at this URL, decorative planters/ornaments are the clear majority so the node was kept rather than dropped. Vintage Collection (Vintage Homeware, Vintage Mirrors) is a distinct, stably-paginated catalog branch (not a marketing landing page) of one-off/restored decorative pieces; Vintage Mirrors likely shares some individual SKUs with the main Mirrors tree and Vintage Homeware is entirely decorative objects (sculptures, candle holders, carved panels) - both kept as their own parent group with the overlap flagged here. One flagged row: Lamp Shades (/lighting/lights/lamp-shades) renders as a fixed Pagebuilder CMS widget (48 identical data-product-id values on both p=1 and p=2, no toolbar pagination, no count header) rather than a live paginated catalog grid - true total is unverifiable so qty is null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than reporting the widget's 48 as a real total.
